dens.definition:
n the habitation of wild animals
n a hiding place; usually a remote place used by outlaws
n a unit of 8 to 10 cub scouts
n a room that is comfortable and secluded

dense.definition:
s. permitting little if any light to pass through because of denseness of matter
s. hard to pass through because of dense growth
s. having high relative density or specific gravity
s. slow to learn or understand; lacking intellectual acuity
dense.translation: a. 密集的, 浓厚的

dense matrix.translation:
[计] 稠密矩阵
[化] 密集矩阵

dense soda ash.translation: [化] 重苏打灰(路布兰法制得的苏打)

dense-phase fluidized bed.translation: [化] 密相床; 密相流化床

densely.translation: adv. 浓密地, 浓厚地

denseness.definition: n. the quality of being mentally slow and limited
denseness.translation: n. 稠密, 浓厚, 密集

denser.definition:
s permitting little if any light to pass through because of denseness of matter
s hard to pass through because of dense growth
s having high relative density or specific gravity
s slow to learn or understand; lacking intellectual acuity
denser.translation:
a. 密集的；浓厚的（dense的比较级）
n. (Denser)人名；(英)登泽

densest.definition:
s. permitting little if any light to pass through because of denseness of matter
s. hard to pass through because of dense growth
s. having high relative density or specific gravity
densest.translation: a. 密集的( dense的最高级 ); 密度大的; 愚笨的; （信息量大得）难理解的

densification.definition: n an increase in the density of something
densification.translation:
[计] 致密, 紧致
[化] 致密化

densimeter.definition: n. a measuring instrument for determining density or specific gravity
densimeter.translation:
n. 比重计, 密度计
[化] 密计度; 比重计

densimetry.translation: n. 密度计的使用(尤指对火药样品密度的测定)

densite.translation: 登斯炸药, 登煞特, 硝胺、硝酸钾 、三硝基甲苯炸药

densities.definition:
n. the amount per unit size
n. the spatial property of being crowded together
densities.translation: n. 密集( density的复数形式 ); 稠密; <物><化>密度（固体、液体或气体单位体积的质量）; 密度（磁盘存贮数据的可用空间）

densitometer.definition: n. a measuring instrument for determining optical or photographic density
densitometer.translation:
n. 光密度计
[计] 密度计

densitometry.definition: n. measuring the optical density of a substance by shining light on it and measuring its transmission
densitometry.translation: n. 测光密度术, 显微测密术

density.definition: n. the amount per unit size

density bottle.translation:
[化] 密度瓶; 密度测定瓶
[医] 密度瓶

density data.translation: [计] 密集数据, 密度数据

density fluids.translation: [化] 密度液(测定矿物粉末密度所用之液体)

density function.translation:
[计] 密度函数
[化] 密度函数

density gradient centrifugation.translation: [化] 密度梯度离心法; 密度梯度离心分离法

density gradient electrophoresis.translation: [化] 密度梯度电泳; 密度梯度电泳法

density of probability.translation: [化] 几率密度; 概率密度

density separation.translation: [化] 密度分离; 密度分离法; 比重分离法

densmore.translation: [人名] 登斯莫尔; [地名] [美国] 登斯莫尔

densography.translation: X 射线照片密度检定法

densometer.translation: n. (纸张)透气度测定仪, 密度计

denson.translation: [人名] [英格兰人姓氏] 丹森取自父名，来源于Dean,含义是“迪安之子”(son of Dean)
